emits.title: provider-neutral context record
emits.summary: one typed envelope for personality blocks, memories, personas, decisions, and research references

emits.title: continuity capsule
emits.summary: explicit records.jsonl and atoms.jsonl compile into capsule JSON, Canon Markdown, and readiness artifacts

emits.title: capsule readiness probe
emits.summary: target acknowledgement challenge bound to one compiled capsule

emits.title: context bootstrap witness
emits.summary: records source state, capsule identity, readiness outcome, and does-not-prove limits

emits.title: read-only Canon MCP surface
emits.summary: status, doctor, blocks, render, validate, and check; this server writes no files

consumes.title: validated records from explicit source files
consumes.summary: JSONL records are parsed and validated before capsule compile or bootstrap

consumes.title: validated bootstrap atoms from explicit source files
consumes.summary: JSONL atoms are parsed and validated before capsule compile or bootstrap

consumes.title: host readiness response
consumes.summary: an optional host response is evaluated against the probe; absent response is reported as unknown

consumes.title: capsule Markdown carrier verification
consumes.summary: re-renders the embedded carrier capsule and reports drift or mismatch
